Used to REHYDRATE a conversational agent's history and to read the artifacts its kickoff needs. The equivalent human route is protected by RBAC; this one, by the service token. `latest=true` returns the TAIL (still in ascending `seq`) and ignores `afterSeq`; `types` restricts the page to those event types. The page is capped at 200 either way (ADR 0060).
